decisions.reason: As an established product line tightly tied to the firm's core geospatial integration capabilities, its continued presence suggests results are at or near aspiration levels and there is little reason to reallocate its resources.

The building data digital twin service still fits the firm's strategic direction and a growing market, so management would retain it despite somewhat uncertain demand while continuing to compare its results with aspirations.

Because the open GIS application development framework reinforces the firm's platform-based solution business and has survived its initial period, it is likely performing sufficiently to justify continued support.

The GIS-specific identity and access service remains close to the core offer, but after dropping the broader authentication product the firm would monitor this adjacent service more critically and keep it only while its results remain acceptable.

The consulting workshop builds directly on existing consulting and training resources, so with modest resource demands and strategic fit the firm would keep it while its market response becomes clearer.
